artifactFormatting: Archived JSON copies use the repository Prettier configuration. Only whitespace and hash-tracking metadata changed; all measurement values are preserved. Artifact sha256 hashes refer to formatted repository copies, while originalSha256 hashes refer to unchanged original measurement files.
codeState: base commit plus working-tree detailed purge fix; not committed
implementation: Scope filters and route filters are applied before the candidate limit, in the deletion transaction.
Select at most routeLimit+1 narrow physical keys; discard the sentinel without reading its details.
Regular selection uses the existing ordered scope/route unique index; exact prefix uses the identity prefix index and current point lookups.
Small eligible epoch buckets use existing scope/connection/epoch counts and index, without scanning the newer RIB.
Details are driven by the bounded temporary keys and physical path primary keys, retaining candidate key order without temporary sorting.
No schema version change, new persistent index, or disabling query statistics.

configuration.load: all benchmark cases run sequentially without competing benchmark loads

timing: Store open/statistics and initial GC excluded. Includes deletion, full synchronous object GC, projections/deltas and the original full-GC adapter orphan checks in the last batch. Low frequency aggregate stage timing added identically to before and after.

comparison.statistic: fixed=mean of two samples; original/historical=median of three samples; see paired Peer comparison below
fixed=mean of two samples; original/historical=median of three samples; see paired Peer comparison below

sameSessionPeerComparison.note: Same machine/runtime and exact seed, same profiling harness, two rounds each, run sequentially during this session. Before and after were not interleaved.

checks: Every million-route sample deleted exactly 1000000 rows in 50 batches
Remaining stale=0, GC candidates=0, identity/payload/attribute orphan=0
Fixed detailed execution plans have no temporary ORDER BY sorting
Benchmark Store source SHA256 matches the final working-tree source
regressionCoverage: prefix with and without prefix length
sparse epoch buckets and remaining budgets
complete route/delta projections and nullable attributes
full GC, transaction rollback and retry
limitations: Synthetic SQLite Store timings exclude parser/writer IPC, TCP, renderer and final Route Assurance rebuild. Small millisecond probes are regression checks, not statistically significant speedup claims.
